name: Miraidon
description: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Dragon Breath
moves.description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Parabolic Charge
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by those hit.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

moves.name: Electro Drift
moves.description: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

moves.name: Metal Sound
moves.description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Mirror Coat
moves.description: A retaliatory attack that counters any special move, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.description: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.description: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Metal Sound
moves.description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Draco Meteor
moves.description: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Heavy Slam
moves.description: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Acrobatics
moves.description: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Dragon Tail
moves.description: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.description: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Dragon Cheer
moves.description: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

moves.name: Supercell Slam
moves.description: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
